en.description:
Extreme Addition® is a unique and extraordinarily simple game that takes you into the world of extreme additions.
You will love this game.
You will boost your mental calculation and your mastery of numbers.
You will gain speed of execution and reasoning.
You will create automatisms.
You will boost your concentration and motivation.
You will gain confidence in yourself.
You will not waste your time.

Are you ready?  So let's go!

In this 3-level game, two numbers are presented to you each turn.
There are 10 rounds in a game and your time is timed and saved if you have 10/10.
You must add these two numbers in an extreme way.
You give your answer by pressing one of the 9 digits.
The answer is always a number between 1 and 9.

At level 1, the two numbers presented are between 1 and 10.
(8 + 7) is equal to 6 in the world of Extreme Addition®.
Why?
Because (8 + 7) = 15, then you separate 15 into (1 + 5) = 6

At level 2, the two numbers presented are between 10 and 99.
(28 + 32) is equal to 6 in the world of Extreme Addition®.
Why?
Because (28 + 32) = 60, then you separate 60 into (6 + 0) = 6

At level 3, the two numbers presented are between 100 and 999.
(102 + 108) is equal to 3 in the world of Extreme Addition®.
Why?
Because (102 + 108) = 210, then you separate 210 into (2 + 1 + 0) = 3

Will you take up the challenge?

Mental arithmetic is the daily maintenance of all your mental faculties!

Here are some tips to save time in your extreme additions:

Tip 1
The result of adding a two-digit number with 9 is quickly obtained from this number as follows:
- The number of units minus 1.
- The tens digit plus 1.
Examples:
(25 + 9) = 34
(46 + 9) = 55
(78 + 9) = 87

Tip 2
The result of the extreme addition of 9 with any number from 1 to 9 equals that number.
Examples:
(4 + 9) => 4 because (4 + 9) = 13 and (1 + 3) = 4
(2 + 9) => 2 because (2 + 9) = 11 and (1 + 1) = 2
(7 + 9) => 7 because (7 + 9) = 16 and (1 + 6) = 7
(9 + 9) => 9 because (9 + 9) = 19 and (1 + 8) = 9

Tip 3
It is faster to add 245 + 637 to the extreme by doing 2 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 3 + 7.

Tip 4
Try to get a maximum of 9 in the longest additions, in order to apply tip # 2.
Here are all the additions to get the number 9:
1 + 8 = 9
2 + 7 = 9
3 + 6 = 9
4 + 5 = 9

Tip 5
Learn by heart your addition tables, so you no longer have to rely on your fingers to find the result! Lol.
7 + 5 = 12
8 + 4 = 12
6 + 7 = 13
8 + 5 = 13
8 + 6 = 14
7 + 8 = 15 etc ...

Be positive, combative, don't give up after a single game, have fun and progress.

(This game is available for WatchOS, iOS, MacOS and Apple TV)
en.releaseNotes: The app is in compliance with EEC regulations.
en.subtitle: Add Numbers To The Extreme.
